newsitem.title: USA: Aetrium buys Forward Systems for $6.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Aetrium buys Forward Systems for $6.5 mln.

text.p: Aetrium Inc said Wednesday it completed its acquisition of the business of Forward Systems Automation Inc, which makes automated test handlers and other equipment for the semiconductor and electronic component industries.
The purchase price was $6.5 million in a combination of cash and Aetrium common stock.
Forward Systems had 1996 revenue of slightly more than $3.0 million. All of its 60 employees have become Aetrium employees.
Aetrium said the transaction is expected to be neutral to Aetrium's 1997 earnings per share, subsequent to a one-time, acquisition-related charge in the second quarter.
Aetrium said it will announce its first quarter results on April 22. At that time, it will more fully discuss the impact of the Forward Systems acquisition on Aetrium's operations.
Aetrium is a leading supplier of proprietary technologies and equipment.
